title: Is the Dragon Draggin'?
summary: For most of the past decade, China has been the saving grace for the tanker, and other, shipping markets. While economic malaise pervaded in the West, China's economic dragon appeared difficult to tame. Recently released data suggest that China's incremental demand growth for transportation fuels may not be as robust as some originally anticipated.
